استكلبت (form X)

# اِسْتَكْلَبْتَ (istaklabta) /is.tak.lab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
# اِسْتَكْلَبْتِ (istaklabti) /is.tak.lab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
# اِسْتَكْلَبَتْ (istaklabat) /is.t
